text_block_list.text:
One day, Symboli Rudolf invites me to
sit in on
her dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today. Did anything strike
you as
requiring attention?

Symboli Rudolf's routine was so flawless,
I can't
think of anything to bring up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
May I assume from your silence that my

performance was acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. If nothing stands out to the
untrained
eye, then I have achieved the
bare minimum at
least.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't say anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll devote a little more attention to
this
song,
however, as it still has room for
improvement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside, there is something
else I was
hoping to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have been looking to broaden my
range by
exploring new dance styles,
but I am uncertain
where to begin.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you have any ideas, please, don't hold
back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm. Cutesy, you say...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That would certainly be out of the norm
for me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no time like the present.
First, you
must tell me exactly what you
consider "cutesy."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So I must smile, wink, and stand pigeon-toed? Haha, there's more to this than I previously appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that won't stop me from rising to the

challenge.

With that, Symboli Rudolf throws herself
into
practicing all kinds of cutesy
routines.

She seems satisfied that the effort has
broadened
her horizons.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Breakdancing? That would certainly be a
new
frontier...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's unlike anything I've attempted
before, but
with it does come a certain
freshness and freedom
of expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I could incorporate it into my
routine, I
think I
would improve dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no time like the present. I
should get
started.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can rely on your assistance, I hope?

And so Symboli Rudolf's horizons
expand once
more, driven by an
insatiable hunger for
self-improvement.
